# Source golden fixture

`source_golden.npz` contains deterministic small arrays for source rotation, rotated points, perspective radius-2 normals/offsets and REL bytes.

It was generated by executing `getRMatrix`, `rotatePC`, `computeNormalsSquareSupport` and `getREL` from the audited server source files:

```bash
python tools/create_source_golden_fixture.py \
  --authoritative-root /home/zhuzhaoziao/RELPlus/CMX-REL \
  --perspective-root /home/zhuzhaoziao/RELPlus/REL-SF4PASS-reference \
  --hha-file /data/bxh_copy/Pano_MA_Seg/utils/hha_util.py \
  --output tests/fixtures/source_golden.npz
```

The fixture is intentionally small so offline tests require only NumPy and OpenCV.
